QuestInfo.name: Explorer Pride
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart in Ereve wants to speak with you.
QuestInfo.2: To prove your dedication, you must complete a simple mission. Talk to Neinheart to find out more.

0.0: How does it feel to awaken to your true self? I have blessed you with the mind of a Cygnus Knight. I do hope that you will carry yourself accordingly. \r\n#L0##bHeck yeah! I'm ready to get down!#l\n#k
0.1: That... will work. I require a service of you, for the sake of peace in Maple World. Come to Ereve and see me.

yes.0: Never compromise with the forces of evil. You must defend peace and honor throughout Maple World. I would have you prove your dedication. Come to see me in Ereve.

no.0: Is it not your duty to protect the honor of the Cygnus Knights?
